summary: Recent updates to the 2D graphics area of Firefox, known as Thebes, focused on improving the performance and consistency of text rendering and printing. Notably, several legacy classes related to painting and rendering text in SVG (Scalable Vector Graphics) have been merged and simplified, making the code easier to maintain and enhancing efficiency. Additionally, the print functionality has been made more consistent by aligning the finishing processes of two different print targets, which ensures users get reliable and uniform output when printing documents. These changes collectively enhance the browser's ability to handle graphics, which is crucial for delivering a smooth visual experience across web pages.  **These improvements not only improve rendering speed but also enhance fidelity in printed materials, ensuring that what you see on-screen is accurately reflected on paper.**
